figurative_meaning_bn: কোন জ্ঞাতব্য বিষয় ঘোষণা করা; চতুর্দিকে রাষ্ট্র করা
figurative_meaning_en: To announce or proclaim a noteworthy matter publicly
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে তার সফলতার খবর চতুর্দিকে ঢেঁড়া পেটা করল।
গ্রামে নতুন মেলার ঘোষণা ঢেঁড়া পেটানো হল।
example_sentences_in_english: He beat the drum about his success news everywhere.
The announcement of the new fair was proclaimed by beating the drum in the village.
history: In traditional Bengali villages, drums like ḍhẽṛā were used to make public announcements for events, gatherings, or news, reflecting pre-modern communication methods.
note: The idiom draws from rural practices where beating a drum signaled important community information.
